Page Header:
- Breadcrumbs: Home > Student Portal > My Notes
- Title: "My Notes" with total notes count badge (e.g., "14 Notes")
- Subtitle: "Your personal notes, video timestamps, and revision formulas across all courses"
- Top Action buttons: "+ New Note" (primary indigo-600 button with plus icon), "Export All Notes" (secondary outlined button with download icon).

Toolbar & Filter Bar:
- Search input with search icon: "Search notes, code snippets, or formulas..."
- Course filter dropdown: "All courses (5)" with options: "Advanced Excel Masterclass", "SQL for Modern Data Analysis", "Power Query & Automated ETL", "Python for Business Dashboards"
- Tag filter or category pills: "All (14)", "Formulas & Syntax (6)", "Key Definitions (4)", "Capstones & Projects (4)"
- Sort dropdown: "Recent first" (options: "Recent first", "Course-wise", "Pinned first")
- Quick view toggle (Compact / Expanded card view)

Two-Pane Workspace Layout:
Left Pane (Note List - approx 38% width):
- List of note cards with clean rounded-xl cards and subtle hover effects:
  1. Card 1 (Active/Selected, Pinned):
     - Pinned icon (indigo/amber pushpin badge)
     - Title: "Power Query M-Code Delimiter Splitting & Error Trapping"
     - Course Chip / Badge: "Advanced Excel Masterclass" (indigo soft pill)
     - Lesson reference: "Section 3 > Lesson 4: Cleaning Messy Data"
     - Timestamp link badge: "⏱ 05:12"
     - 2-line preview: "Always convert dates to text first if parsing locale mismatches (e.g. DD/MM vs MM/DD) before invoking Table.TransformColumns. Split by delimiter at leftmost..."
     - Edited metadata: "Edited 2 mins ago" · "3 tags"
  2. Card 2:
     - Title: "Window Functions: DENSE_RANK() vs RANK() Partition Nuances"
     - Course Chip: "SQL for Modern Data Analysis" (emerald/teal soft pill)
     - Lesson reference: "Section 2 > Lesson 7: Advanced Ranking & Over()"
     - Timestamp link badge: "⏱ 14:35"
     - 2-line preview: "DENSE_RANK doesn't skip positions when duplicates occur (1, 2, 2, 3), whereas RANK leaves gaps (1, 2, 2, 4). Critical for financial tier classification..."
     - Edited metadata: "Edited Yesterday"
  3. Card 3:
     - Title: "Pandas Chained Assignment Warning (.loc vs slice copies)"
     - Course Chip: "Python for Business Dashboards" (amber soft pill)
     - Lesson reference: "Section 1 > Lesson 12: DataFrames & Slicing"
     - Timestamp link badge: "⏱ 22:04"
     - 2-line preview: "SettingWithCopyWarning happens when modifying a view instead of original df. Always use df.loc[row_indexer, col_indexer] = value..."
     - Edited metadata: "Edited 3 days ago"
  4. Card 4:
     - Title: "DAX CALCULATE() Context Transition & FILTER() Caveat"
     - Course Chip: "Executive BI Dashboards" (purple soft pill)
     - Lesson reference: "Section 4 > Lesson 2: Context Transition"
     - Timestamp link badge: "⏱ 08:45"
     - 2-line preview: "Row context does not automatically filter other tables unless wrapped in CALCULATE(). When filtering large fact tables, prefer KEEPFILTERS..."
     - Edited metadata: "Edited Oct 18, 2024"

Right Pane (Interactive Rich Note Editor - approx 62% width):
- Note Header Container:
  - Course and lesson breadcrumb chips: "Advanced Excel Masterclass > Section 3: Power Query > Lesson 4: Cleaning Messy Data"
  - Direct video jump link button with play icon: "Jump to Video at 05:12" (subtle indigo tint button)
  - Pin toggle button (active), Favorite star, and Share/Copy note button
- Note Title Input:
  - Large styled editable title: "Power Query M-Code Delimiter Splitting & Error Trapping"
- Rich Text Formatting Toolbar:
  - Formatting icons: Bold (B), Italic (I), Strikethrough, Heading 2 (H2), Code block (`{}`), Bullet list, Numbered list, Blockquote, Highlight marker (yellow/amber tint), Insert Formula/Snippet fx, Attach File.
- Rich Editor Content Body:
  - Styled content area showing authentic, formatted student notes:
    - Callout tip box (slate-50 with indigo-600 left border): "💡 Key Rule: Never skip locale conversion when consuming mixed European and US corporate CSV ledger feeds."
    - Bullet points:
      • Always convert dates to text first if parsing locale mismatches (e.g. DD/MM vs MM/DD) before invoking `Table.TransformColumns`.
      • Split by delimiter at leftmost delimiter index using `SplitTextByDelimiter("-", QuoteStyle.None)`.
      • For dirty numeric columns with currency strings ($ / €), strip symbols via regex or `Text.Select` prior to `type number` casting.
    - Code Snippet Box (dark slate-900 background with syntax highlighting):
      ```powerquery
      // M-Code Snippet from Lesson 4
      Splits = Table.SplitColumn(CleanedCols, "Invoice_Raw",
          SplitTextByDelimiter("-", QuoteStyle.None),
          {"TransactionDate", "Region_Code", "Invoice_ID"})
      ```
    - Quick reference tag pills: `#mcode`, `#powerquery`, `#datacleaning`, `#exam-revision`
- Editor Footer Bar:
  - Left: Auto-save status indicator with checkmark: "Auto-saved 2 mins ago" · "184 words · 1,120 characters"
  - Right: Actions group:
    - Red ghost button: "Delete Note" (with trash icon)
    - Outlined button: "Discard Changes"
    - Primary solid Indigo-600 button: "Save Changes" (with checkmark/save icon)

Style & Polish:
- Match BICE design system: Inter font, crisp hierarchy, white cards on soft background, subtle borders (border-slate-200), slate-900 typography, indigo-600 primary accents, rounded-xl cards, rounded-lg buttons and inputs.
